title: Refined Shields
description: "Tired of the same old plain shields? Refined Shields gives your defense a fresh new look without changing the feel of Minecraft!"
body:
✨ Tired of the same old vanilla shield? Refined Shields gives your shield a fresh new look while keeping the game’s original style intact.

This lightweight resource pack doesn’t change your Minecraft graphics overall, but it carefully retextures shields to feel cleaner, sharper, and more immersive. Whether you’re blocking arrows in PvP or surviving against mobs, your shield now looks better than ever without adding any lag.
